features.description: The 2D outline of the vase from the front view, defining the radius at each height.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: The vase is assumed to be rotationally symmetric around the vertical axis (Z) based on the single silhouette view.
The base is assumed to be flat for stability, though the drawing shows a curved bottom.
generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a rotationally symmetric vase. The front view provides the profile curve. The profile will be revolved 360 degrees around the Z-axis to create the 3D solid. The maximum dimension is set to 120mm.

unresolved_constraints: Wall thickness is not specified; the object will be generated as a solid.

user_intent.description: Greek vase from a single silhouette

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
